rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A gateway server built by Kirha AI that provides access to their specialized tool planning API for cryptocurrency-related queries through a configurable MCP interface. The implementation uses a containerized Express.js server with streamable HTTP transport, automatically routing crypto questions to Kirha's internal analysis system with built-in summarization capabilities using their kirha-flash model. It features flexible configuration through JSON files and query parameters, supports stateless operation with per-request API key handling, and includes comprehensive debugging capabilities for troubleshooting authentication issues, making it useful for integrating AI assistants with specialized crypto knowledge bases and ensuring accurate pre-validated results before falling back to web searches.
